title: Cross-host mail receipts say durableButNotWoken ('requires central activation') even when the satellite is Active and the wake succeeds
outcome: A cross-host send's receipt and row state never claim 'not woken / requires central activation' unless activation is actually missing. When the wake is asynchronous, the receipt says so, for example 'durable; wake pending', and the later state reflects the real outcome.
acceptance: A note on master identifies, with file and line, where the activation-prerequisite cause is inserted (reported at public_mailbox_relay_receipt:64-66) and where the row's notificationState for a relay message is set, and states why both legs of the 2026-10-26 proof read durableButNotWoken although both wakes happened.

Fix criteria are proposed separately and concurred by the coordinator; any fix reuses the existing receipt and wake-outcome path, with no duplicate state. No implementation under Greg's STOP without an exemption.
